description:
Initialization: Assign tasks (ascending ID) to satellite with most feasible candidates; 
tie-break by least assigned duration, then smaller ID. Unassigned if no candidates.

Reassignment (unscheduled tasks by descending reward, then task ID):
- Migration: Test non-owner satellites with candidates (ascending satellite ID).
- Swap: After migrations exhaust, test task pairs (ascending task IDs) with distinct owners 
and mutual candidates.
- Acceptance: Require feasibility and strictly higher profit; restart from Migration.
- Termination: Move exhaustion or budget limit.
